title: tron.trade_intent.v1
description: Canonical executable intent produced by TRON's negotiation stage (canonical lifecycle step 10) from a falcon.trade_action.v1. Contract-owner: WI-B (WO-TRON-D1). Defines structure/constraints only; negotiation rule behaviour is owned elsewhere (CAP-03 / WI-E, WI-F).

nonnegative_decimal_string.description: Exact non-negative decimal representation (HR-05). Never a binary float.

decimal_string.description: Exact decimal representation, sign permitted (HR-05). Never a binary float.

protection.description: A stop-loss/take-profit pair. When a protection object is present, both legs are required together (HR-01 applies to OPEN intents).

contract_version.description: Canonical contract major version. Must equal "1" for tron.trade_intent.v1.

intent_id.description: Stable identifier for this negotiated intent. Used for idempotency (HR-13) and correlation (HR-15).

source_action_id.description: action_id of the falcon.trade_action.v1 this intent was negotiated from.

canonical_instrument.description: The upstream (pre-negotiation) canonical instrument identifier, copied from the source action.

broker_instrument.description: The broker-resolved instrument symbol produced by TRON's symbol mapping at the negotiation boundary.

direction.description: Negotiated directional side for this intent.

canonical_requested_quantity.description: The upstream canonical requested quantity, in canonical (non-lot) units, decimal-string per HR-05. This contract records whatever value negotiation received; it does not decide whether that value originates upstream or from TRON sizing policy (DEC-OPEN-04 remains OPEN).

negotiated_quantity.description: The broker-valid quantity produced by TRON's negotiation boundary (HR-09: broker-specific quantity conversion happens here, not upstream). Still an exact decimal string, not a raw binary float.

requested_protection.description: The protection (stop-loss/take-profit) requested by the source action, prior to negotiation. Absent means the source action's type does not carry a protection request applicable at this stage (for example, an intent not derived from an OPEN action); this contract does not decide which action types require protection — see HR-01 and WI-F.

negotiated_protection.description: The protection (stop-loss/take-profit) TRON actually intends to submit to the broker after negotiation. Absent has the same meaning as for requested_protection: not applicable to this intent's type, not a waiver of HR-01 for OPEN intents.

permitted_adjustments.description: Adjustments negotiation was permitted to make to the canonical request, each attributed to the rule responsible. Absent or an empty array both mean: no adjustments were made during negotiation. These two representations are equivalent.

rule_id.description: Stable identifier of the configured rule responsible for this adjustment.

original_value.description: Value before adjustment, when representable as a single decimal string.

adjusted_value.description: Value after adjustment, when representable as a single decimal string.

config_identities.description: Map of configuration-file identity name (e.g. "mapping", "routing", "selection", "sizing", "execution") to the hash/version identity of the configuration responsible for this negotiation (HR-15, section 10). Deliberately an open-keyed map: the set of configuration files is defined in 07-CONFIGURATION.md (WI-D), not by this contract.

created_at_ms.description: When this intent record was created.

negotiated_at_ms.description: When negotiation for this intent completed.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier tying this intent to its source action and downstream execution/journal/event records (HR-15).
